title: SPE Chapter 05 — Autoload
_comment: VET THIS FILE before rendering. lane 'app' = running page (optional 'js' Base API); lane 'code' = self-contained page from local source, lines hl highlighted. Rebuild: RESYNTH=1 bash scripts/make-episode.sh 05-Autoload

scenes.narr: Chapter five changes nothing you can see, and everything about how the code is organised. Every class now lives in its own file.
The front controller shrank to almost nothing: require Composer's autoloader once, then build the context and run Init.
That autoloader is configured here — a namespace prefix mapped to a directory. This is the PSR-4 standard, and it is the whole point of the chapter.
When a request arrives, Init builds a class name from that namespace and the requested plugin, and simply creates it.
Naming the class is enough — the autoloader turns that name into a file path and loads it, so there is not a single include statement anywhere.
The same guard as before protects it: if the name is not a real plugin, the request becomes a clean 404.
The abstract base still defines the five default actions, each returning a not-implemented stub — unchanged, just now in its own file.
A concrete plugin is tiny: Home's model overrides list and returns its data, living in its own namespaced folder.
Its view sits right beside it, turning that data into the card you see on screen.
And Theme still builds the navigation with the pipe operator, exactly as it did before the move.
The dual output survives the reorganisation too: ask for JSON, and Init answers before the theme ever runs.
Same data, still available as JSON, from a codebase that is now properly filed away.
That is chapter five: identical behaviour, professionally organised, autoloaded by Composer. Next, chapter six adds sessions and flash messages.
